component.name: Turing Smart Screen
component.summary: Configure and manage Turing Smart Screen hardware displays

description.p: Turing Smart Screen is a Linux desktop application for configuring compatible Turing, XuanFang, TURZX, Kipye and WeAct hardware monitor displays.
It includes GTK4 configuration tools, theme management, system monitoring, video overlay support and display control.
First stable Flatpak release, validated on physical Turing Smart Screen Rev. C hardware.
